Interface NetSerializer<D>

Type Parameters:
D - the value to encode/decode
All Superinterfaces:
NetDecode<D>, NetEncode<D>
public interface NetSerializer<D> extends NetEncode<D>, NetDecode<D>
Both a NetEncode and NetDecode.

All general net encode/decoders within Cyrus are both, however some packets will develop there own decoders and encoders to suit what the packet is doing Note: You can get the Cyrus built in or even develop your own using Cyrus's own using the NetSerializerBuilder.builder()
